text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, less typing in the parking lot.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, so managers finally saw next steps and objections without chasing people.

**3. Consent matters.** Some buyers hesitated. Reps who opened with a clear, friendly heads-up earned trust fast.

**4. Adoption wasn't automatic.** Usage jumped only after we shared example summaries and let reps edit templates.

**5. Coaching improved.** Managers used call highlights instead of ride-alongs alone.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It freed reps to use more of it.

What did your team learn from piloting AI?
